correctness.rationale: The open common-neighbor facet criterion on the 21 unordered pairs generates exactly 18,495 augmented faces (18,494 nonempty) with the specified full 10-entry face vector. Independent reconstruction of greedy deterministic vertex toggles yielded 9,121 augmented matching pairs, including the empty-face match; after deleting it, exactly one critical vertex, 246 critical three-cells and seven critical four-cells survive. Independently built all 98,805 ordinary Hasse incidences and topologically sorted the reversed matching graph on all 18,494 ordinary faces. Signed integer gradient-path recursion on the critical 4-cell boundaries gave seven identically zero columns in the 246x7 Morse differential, not merely zero mod2. The 3-skeleton is a wedge of S3s; by pi3/H3 Hurewicz each 4-cell attaches nullhomotopically, so full integral wedge follows. Independent mod2 simplex-boundary ranks agree exactly (20,190,1000,2534,2646,1764,756,189,21). Pure dim9 with homology in dims3 and4 is non-shellable. This is an exact finite homotopy classification, not a theorem for all T_n.
residual_risks: Exact finite checks do not generalize outside the claim domain.
